product_summary: Gitea is a self-hosted Git service for code, issues and pull requests.

workflows.title: Create a private repository with a README
workflows.title_en: Create a private repository with a README
workflows.goal: Create a repository owned by demo named website-release-checklist-2026 with description 'Pre-release checklist and deployment notes for the website'. Make it private, enable repository initialization with a README, and set the default branch to main. Leave unrelated options at their defaults.
workflows.path_hint: Dashboard → New Repository (+) → Owner, Repository Name, Make repository private, Description, Initialize Repository, Default Branch → Create Repository
workflows.preconditions: Logged in as demo, who can create repositories. No repository with the same name exists.

sample_data.value: Pre-release checklist and deployment notes for the website

workflows.success_criteria: The demo/website-release-checklist-2026 repository opens, is marked private, and contains a README on the main branch.
workflows.unverified: English UI labels assumed from the Korean run.
